subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should allowed elevated sessions default to host exec with approvals, or should implicit elevation stay off unless a caller explicitly opts into elevated execution?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes the sandbox escape default and the current documented /elevated ask contract, so automation should not choose the security/product policy by itself.

options.title: Default implicit elevation off
options.body: Treat tools.elevated.enabled as availability only, requiring agents.defaults.elevatedDefault, /elevated on|ask|full, or exec(elevated:true) before host routing occurs.

options.title: Keep current session-host default
options.body: Leave allowed elevated sessions defaulting to host exec with approvals and explicitly document the tradeoff and required sandbox-preserving workaround.

options.title: Add a separate opt-in mode
options.body: Preserve current /elevated ask behavior but add a distinct sandbox-default/per-call-elevation mode with clear docs and tests.

recommendation.title: Default implicit elevation off
recommendation.body: Treat tools.elevated.enabled as availability only, requiring agents.defaults.elevatedDefault, /elevated on|ask|full, or exec(elevated:true) before host routing occurs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the elevated docs, directive resolution, and security hardening paths that define this contract.
